name: Playnet
purpose: A shared plan for people who already trust each other: say what you have and need, and a planner over ValueFlows data finds the match.
licence: AGPL-3.0 with additional terms (Section 7: attribution, marking changed planner protocols, names)

stack.didMethods: did:keri (an AID with a did:keri: prefix, resolvable over HTTP at the gateway)
stack.credentials: ACDC over KERI; the First Person credential set (personhood, relationship, contact points, device authorization) rendered as ACDCs
stack.transport: Goblins actors over OCapN: WebSocket to the gateway, WebRTC between browsers, Reticulum mesh (LoRa, serial, I2P, packet radio, TCP), Tor
stack.trustTasks: none; ValueFlows vocabulary (needs, offers, processes, commitments, recipes)
stack.groups: scopes (Goblins vats) in a federation tree; rules, state and history as Scheme expressions; logged, revocable capabilities
stack.devices: KERI AID per person, keys derived in the browser from a passcode; recovery on another device with the same passcode

offline: partial: device copy, actions wait for the gateway

credentials.note: First Person set as ACDCs; personhood issued after k witnesses who met the person sign (k-of-n ceremony). Not W3C VC, so DTG exchange needs a bridge.

messaging.viaName: LoRa, serial, I2P, packet radio, TCP

messaging.note: Browser to browser; peers find each other only through the gateway.

replication.note: Scope state lives in Goblins vats at the gateway; a device holds a copy and queues actions while offline.

requiredParty: a gateway: the trust root that introduces peers, holds key event logs and runs the scopes
